Edit image 1. It is a photo of the client's own room, and the result must still be that same room, exactly: the same camera position, angle, lens and framing; the same walls, ceiling, floor, light fixture and outlets; the same windows, with the same frames, in the same places. Do not add, remove, move or enlarge any wall, window, door or opening, do not extend, rotate or crop the room, and do not change its light. Wherever no new furniture goes, the result is image 1 unchanged.

Images 2 to 10 are the products to add, one photo each:
image 2: tall solid wood bookcase, 90 cm wide, 2 units
image 3: cantilever bentwood leather lounge armchair, size unknown
image 4: swing-arm floor lamp with drum shade, size unknown
image 5: round two-tier side table, size unknown
image 6: natural sheepskin rug, size unknown
image 7: cable-knit throw blanket, size unknown
image 8: rust red linen-look cushion, size unknown
image 9: pair of linen curtains, size unknown
image 10: braided money tree houseplant, size unknown

Add exactly these products and nothing else: no other furniture, lamps, plants, rugs or decoration than these (books on the shelves of a bookcase are fine). Each one must be the product of its photo, not a similar one: the same design, proportions, colors and materials. A product listed with "2 units" goes twice.

The client asked: "Quiero transformar este cuarto en un rincón de lectura acogedor. Lo principal es una biblioteca grande y alta, de madera oscura como el piso, contra la pared de la izquierda, que ocupe buena parte de esa pared y donde entren muchos libros. Junto a la ventana, un sillón cómodo para leer con una lámpara de pie al lado y una mesita para apoyar el café. En el piso, una alfombra redonda clara. Que todo se sienta cálido, con maderas y textiles naturales.". Arrange the products as an interior designer would for that, against the walls and on the floor that image 1 shows, each at its real size for this room, lit by this room's light. The result must look like a real photograph of image 1's room.
